title: Fragile Cargo
description: Stow awkward parcels on your delivery boat's deck grid, then slide them mid-crossing to lean against announced waves — sustained tilt sends the low-side cargo overboard. Deliver the manifest, bonus freight pays extra.
controls: Mouse/Touch: drag parcels from the dock, tap a parcel then a green cell to move it
R or Rotate button: rotate the parcel being dragged
credits: Concept and game design direction: Cédric Bernadac
